newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers sees Q4 above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers sees Q4 above estimates.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said on Friday that its fourth quarter earnings are expected to top Wall Street estimates, with earnings available to common shareholders of at least $8 million, or $0.48 a share.
Securities analysts had a consensus earnings estimate of $0.44 a share for Cross Timbers's fourth quarter, the company said, citing surveys by Zack's Investment Research and First Call.
The company earlier disclosed these details about its results at a meeting of securities analysts in the Cayman Islands today.
Cross Timbers, an oil and gas company, said cash flow from operations before changes in working capital is expected to exceed $25 million or $1.50 per primary share.
Stronger commodities prices and higher production levels helped the company's results, Cross Timbers said.
Cross Timbers said it expects higher earnings and cash flow in the first quarter of 1997, given current oil and gas prices.
Fourth quarter results, which are subject to audit, will be released February 20, Cross Timbers said.
